name: mirage
text:
v1.0.54 is out. Install it, try one Kalshi bet, and send me what the red text on the card says now: it shows Kalshi's own error code and detail. That tells me the real reason (nothing in the app checks your Kalshi cash itself; the message only appears when Kalshi's answer says insufficient funds, and the engine reads $6.29 in your account).
